entries.title: MULLET MADJACK

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: MULLET MADJACK launched first on Windows PC, then came to Xbox One/Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch; the PC version remains the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route with no sourced console-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy MULLET MADJACK on Steam or GOG for Windows PC. Xbox and Switch versions are good convenience routes, but PC is the archive-preferred version.

all_releases.reason: primary: original platform and best fidelity/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Xbox and Switch releases are ports/access routes, not separate remasters or definitive editions. Xbox Game Pass/Cloud availability is an access route, not a separate version.
